builds.name: Starlight's Touch: five-charge HP/AP heal
builds.summary: Investigate a high five-charge Starlight's Touch per recipient result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate a high five-charge Starlight's Touch per recipient result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: At five charges, Q heals 5 times (25 + 0.15 AP + 1% caster maximum HP), or 125 + 0.75 AP + 5% max HP per eligible recipient before healing modifiers. HP and Riftmaker's HP-to-AP conversion interact with Deathcap; Staff/Redemption test outgoing heal power against a pure HP or AP slot. Item active healing and Aery are separate.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum selected ability rank, minute 30. Enemy benchmark is 3000 max HP, 100 armor and 50 MR before named debuffs. No dragons, elixirs, allied stat buffs or free permanent stacks. Read actual stats and item/rune states from the client. Report raw potential separately from damage actually dealt; no post-death packets. Exactly five legally earned charges. One allied recipient has 6000 max HP and enough missing HP; do not multiply by every ally. No assumed Staff AP buff unless legally triggered before this cast; record that buff separately. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 30%, prior champion combat 4s; Gathering Storm minute 30 if selected. Earned Heartsteel HP is 0. For this heal metric the form's target fields refer to the allied recipient: 6000 maximum HP, 30% current HP. Enemy damage benchmark resistances are unused.
